q24.

```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178          // useCreateMemo() → calls memoServiceClient.createMemo (line 183)
web/src/connect.ts:197                        // memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21           // rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo)
server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go:306 // ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo → delegates to APIV1Service
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70      // APIV1Service.CreateMemo → s.Store.CreateMemo (line 115)
store/memo.go:109                            // Store.CreateMemo → validates UID, calls s.driver.CreateMemo

```

Notes on the boundaries:

- **Transport hop**: the generated client stub the frontend actually invokes is `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` (schema) driven through Connect-RPC; the Go server side of the same contract is `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go:99` / `:409`.
- **Dispatch seam** is `store/driver.go:29` — `Store` never touches SQL, it forwards to whichever driver is wired. Sibling dialect drivers with the same shape: `store/db/mysql/memo.go:16` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`.
- The handler at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` also fans out post-insert to `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15`) and an SSE broadcast (line 162), and converts back with `convertMemoFromStore` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:23`).
